candidates.name: Etanercept-induced interstitial lung disease
support_spans: After the third dose, she developed a dry cough and dyspnea on moderate exertion

candidates.why: The patient developed respiratory symptoms after starting etanercept, and the chest CT findings are consistent with interstitial lung disease.
